title: Qcqs criterion from affine inverse images
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose that for every affine open $U\subseteq S$, the open subscheme $X_U=f^{-1}(U)$ is quasi-compact (every open covering of its underlying space has a finite subcover) and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Then $f$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism].
